description: Upstream data of the earth tile set (bake-earth). Every source can be swapped by changing the module named in 'module' and re-running the matching bake.py step; licences are what the credits screen must show.

sources.resolution: 15 arc-second (463 m), 288 GeoTIFF tiles of 15 x 15 deg, EGM2008 heights, ice surface, bathymetry
sources.licence: Public domain (NOAA NCEI). Cite: NOAA National Centers for Environmental Information 2022, ETOPO 2022 15 Arc-Second Global Relief Model, DOI 10.25921/fd45-gt74

sources.resolution: z15 (4.5 m pixels at 19 N) over land and 3.5 km of coast; USGS 3DEP 1/3 arc-second (10 m) in Hawai'i
sources.licence: AWS Terrain Tiles / Mapzen Terrarium, free with attribution per https://github.com/tilezen/joerd/blob/master/docs/attribution.md (USGS 3DEP public domain)

sources.resolution: 15 arc-second, 8 JPEG quadrants of 21600 x 21600, August 2004 cloud-free composite, base map without relief shading
sources.licence: Public domain (NASA Earth Observatory, Reto Stockli, NASA GSFC)
sources.processing: Topographic de-shading (deshade.py) fitted per 5 deg latitude band against ETOPO normals

sources.resolution: z14 (9 m) within 10 km of land, z12 (36 m) offshore; per-pixel median of the years in the region file
sources.licence: CC BY-NC-SA 4.0 - Sentinel-2 cloudless - https://s2maps.eu by EOX IT Services GmbH (Contains modified Copernicus Sentinel data). NON-COMMERCIAL: replace before any commercial release.
sources.replacement: Any orthorectified true-colour mosaic delivered as XYZ tiles (e.g. a Landsat/HLS or licensed Sentinel-2 mosaic): change S2_URL in merc.py and 'sources.albedo' of the region file; colour matching and feathering are source-independent.

sources.licence: Public domain (NASA Earth Observatory, Suomi NPP VIIRS)
sources.processing: Moonlit Blue-Marble background of the published composite removed (fitted linear model on BMNG plus a blue-residue rule)

sources.resolution: 250 m (GIBS TileMatrix 8), only tiles that can contain land

layers: watermask (regional levels: inland water and dry depressions)
sources.licence: CC BY 4.0 - ESA WorldCover project 2021 / Contains modified Copernicus Sentinel data (2021) processed by ESA WorldCover consortium

sources.resolution: 8192 x 4096, near-real-time IR composite (snapshot taken at bake time)
sources.licence: Unstated by the third-party service (derived from EUMETSAT/NOAA/JMA geostationary data). CAVEAT: treat as unlicensed for redistribution; swap for the fallback or a GIBS/GOES composite before shipping.

layers: globals/cloudCoverage (|lat| > 62 deg; documented fallback for the whole map)
sources.licence: CC BY 4.0 (Solar System Scope, based on NASA imagery)
